articles.title: Carlos Baleba transfer: Manchester United complete signing of Cameroon midfielder from Brighton
articles.summary: Sky Sports News has been reporting on United's interest in Baleba since last autumn and broke the news that they enquired about signing him during the January transfer window; the Cameroon international signs a five-year deal at Old Trafford
articles.body:
The Cameroon international, 22, joins the club in a deal worth up to £70m, made up of a £65m guaranteed fee plus £5m in add-ons.

He has signed a five-year contract which includes the option of a further year.

Baleba is currently injured, having picked up an ankle injury in pre-season, but Sky Sports News understands he could be back by mid-September. Manchester United play Manchester City on September 13, live on Sky Sports .

Baleba's arrival at Old Trafford brings an end to a transfer saga that has lasted almost 12 months. Sky Sports News has been reporting on United's interest in Baleba since last autumn and broke the news that they enquired about signing him during the January transfer window.

He remained one of United's top targets this summer and becomes their third addition in midfield after Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans .

"It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams. Playing at Old Trafford is always special but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour," Baleba told the club's website.

"I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick; his experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me reach the highest level.

"The ambition of everyone at the club is extremely clear, the future is hugely exciting, and I am determined to play my part in delivering the success that we are capable of together."

Baleba joined Brighton from Lille in 2023 and made 112 appearances for the club. He featured 35 times last season and was absent for a spell while representing Cameroon at the Africa Cup of Nations.

'I had no idea what this club would become' - Baleba pens Brighton farewell

Upon the announcement of the news, Baleba took to social media to post an emotional farewell to Brighton.

"I came here at 19 with little English and no idea what this club would become to me," he wrote.

"Brighton only asked me to be myself. The staff who make the club run so well. The team-mates who took the time to understand me, on the pitch and off it. The nights at the Amex when I heard my name from that stand always made me feel at home.

"To all of the fans, staff and my team-mates. You looked after me and for that I will hold you all close to my heart. Wherever I play, this club is in how I play. Good luck Seagulls."

Is Baleba a major gamble or a game-changer for Man Utd?

Analysis by Sky Sports' William Bitibiri:

A year ago, Carlos Baleba appeared to have the world at his feet.

A breakout season at Brighton had established the then-21-year-old as one of the Premier League's most coveted young midfielders, with a move to one of Europe's elite clubs seemingly inevitable. Manchester United were among those interested, having identified Baleba as a potential transformative presence in midfield.

But Brighton's reported £100m-plus valuation proved a stumbling block. The move never materialised and Baleba stayed at the Amex.

His form subsequently dipped dramatically. His numbers fell and, at times, he looked a shadow of the midfielder who had generated so much excitement the previous season.

That makes this a gamble for United. But, stylistically, there are few midfielders better suited to what they need.

United require greater authority in the middle of the pitch and, crucially, someone capable of winning the ball back in deeper areas. Baleba brings exactly that. His athleticism, aggression and ability to carry the ball through midfield would add a level of dynamism and steel that is currently missing.

Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans have been astute additions, but Baleba offers something different: specialist defensive power coupled with the athleticism to drive United up the pitch.

His age is another major factor. Baleba is still only 22 and, despite his inconsistent season, there remains a belief around him that he can develop into one of the world's best midfielders.

That ambition is reflected in his influences. Baleba has spoken of his admiration for Paul Pogba, Yaya Toure and Andres Iniesta, while Neymar and Ronaldinho were among his favourite players to watch. There is a desire for self-expression in his game that goes beyond the physical qualities that made so highly rated.

There is risk attached to signing him. United would be betting on the player Baleba can become rather than simply the one he has been over the past 12 months.

But if United want to find a midfielder capable of growing into one of the best in his position, this is exactly the sort of gamble they should be willing to take.

articles.title: LASK to hold silence for Celtic fan who died during Champions League match
articles.summary: The 65-year-old supporter took ill during the first leg of the Champions League play-off in Glasgow last week.
articles.body:
Austrian champions LASK have held a silence in memory of a Celtic supporter who died when the sides met in Glasgow last week.

The 65-year-old fan became ill in the stadium during the first leg of the Champions League play-off at Celtic Park on Wednesday.

He was taken to Glasgow Royal Infirmary but died a short time later.

Ahead of the return leg in Linz - which kicked off at 20:00 - LASK confirmed they wished to pay tribute to the supporter.

Duran scores twice as Celtic beat LASK to take big step towards Champions League

During the silence, fans held a banner that read: "Rest in peace, James".

Writing on social media, Celtic said: "LASK has contacted Celtic to advise that they wish to observe a period of silence prior to tonight's match in tribute to our supporter who fell ill and tragically passed away following last week's first leg at Celtic Park.

"We send our thanks and appreciation to LASK."

Last week Celtic thanked the emergency services and fellow fans for their efforts in dealing with the "tragic incident".

A club statement added: "We extend our deepest condolences, thoughts and prayers to the family and we will ensure that we offer them our full support at this extremely difficult time."

Martin O'Neill's team hold a 3-0 advantage going into the match at the Raiffeisen Arena.

The winner will progress to the lucrative group stage of the Champions League.

articles.title: ACC Considering Rule Change Barring NFL Players from Returning to CFB Amid Big Ten Rumors
articles.summary: Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.
articles.body:
Following in the Big Ten's footsteps, the ACC is reportedly considering a rule change that could prohibit schools from adding players who were previously in the NFL.

On Tuesday, the Big Ten reportedly passed a rule preventing NFL players from returning to college, per ESPN's Pete Thamel.

Now the ACC is looking to pass a similar rule, per Ralph D. Russo, Chris Vannini, Scott Dochterman and Seth Emerson of The Athletic .

"The ACC is considering a similar conference-wide rule, Wake Forest athletic director and ACC athletic director chair John Currie told The Athletic. The league's athletic directors have a regularly scheduled meeting Wednesday, and this discussion will be part of the agenda."

The Big 12 is reporting considering a similar ban, per Ross Dellenger of Yahoo Sports.

On Monday, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that undrafted free agent tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who was waived by the Cleveland Browns, has an agreement to play for LSU.

A Louisiana judge's temporary restraining order has carved the path for Wright to return to college, where he played for Virginia Tech in 2022 and 2023 and Ole Miss in 2024 and 2025.

Wright is among 33 athletes who can could gain an extra collegiate season. He is one of three athletes who signed with a pro team but can choose that path alongside running back Anthony Hankerson (Miami Dolphins and Seattle Seahawks) and linebacker Jack Pyburn (Tampa Bay Buccaneers). Hankerson has been waived, while Pyburn is still on the Bucs' roster.

Some big-name coaches had mixed opinions on NFL players returning to college. Oregon head coach Dan Lanning was clearly opposed to it, while Ohio State head coach Ryan Day was at least open to the matter.

The Big Ten has ultimately shut the door on the possibility. The ACC may follow suit.

The SEC doesn't like the practice either and released a statement on the matter, but there wasn't word on whether the conference would pass a rule banning it.

It seems like a common-sense move to ban pro players from returning to school. The situation still has to play itself out, though, as news continuously develops on the matter.

articles.summary: El formato se mantiene respecto de las dos temporadas anteriores
articles.body: La UEFA Champions League 2026/27 arrancará su 72.ª edición histórica (la 35.ª bajo el nombre de Liga de Campeones y la tercera estrenando la fase de liga). El torneo echó a andar el 7 de julio de 2026 con la clasificación previa y bajará el telón el 5 de junio de 2027 con la gran final en el Estadio Metropolitano de Madrid. El formato se mantiene respecto de las dos temporadas anteriores. Los 36 clubes estarán reunidos en una única tabla y cada uno disputará ocho partidos contra ocho adversarios diferentes: cuatro como local y cuatro como visitante. Los ocho mejores clasificarán directamente a octavos de final, mientras que los ubicados entre el noveno y el vigesimocuarto puesto deberán disputar los playoffs de la fase eliminatoria. Los equipos que finalicen del puesto 25 al 36 quedarán eliminados. La primera jornada de la fase liga tendrá una particularidad: se desarrollará durante tres días, del 8 al 10 de septiembre. El resto de las fechas se disputará principalmente entre martes y miércoles. El Estadio Metropolitano albergará por segunda vez el partido decisivo el sábado 5 de junio de 2027. En 2019, la casa del Atlético de Madrid presenció el triunfo del Liverpool frente al Tottenham (2-0) para alzarse con su sexta corona europea. Con esta cita, Madrid albergará por sexta ocasión la final de la máxima competición continental, solo superada por Londres en número de finales albergadas.

articles.title: Carlos Espí no se separa de sus abuelas: de la salvación del Levante a la presentación con el Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: El delantero valenciano, que posó con María y Conchín tras la victoria clave frente al Mallorca, llevó a sus yayas al acto de la firma por el club blanco
articles.summary: El delantero valenciano, que posó con María y Conchín tras la victoria clave frente al Mallorca, llevó a sus yayas al acto de la firma por el club blanco
articles.body: Tres meses después de aquella imagen entrañable en el Ciutat de València, Carlos Espí volvió a elegir a sus dos abuelas para uno de los momentos más importantes de su vida. Si en mayo quiso inmortalizar con María y Conchín la victoria que acercó al Levante a la permanencia, en agosto las sentó junto a su familia en su presentación como nuevo jugador del Real Madrid, cerrando así un círculo que ayuda a explicar quién es y cómo es el delantero valenciano más allá de los goles. Este domingo en la Ciudad Deportiva de Valdebebas, junto al presidente Florentino Pérez, Espí compareció como nuevo futbolista blanco hasta 2031. Pero entre los invitados había dos rostros especialmente familiares para quienes habían seguido su irrupción en LaLiga: María y Conchín, las dos abuelas con las que protagonizó una de las fotografías más emotivas de la pasada temporada. Durante una entrevista concedida a los medios oficiales del club blanco, el delantero explicó que ni siquiera ellas conocían el desenlace de la operación hasta última hora. “Ahora están aquí mis abuelas, pero tampoco sabían nada. Ni mis amigos, nadie sabía nada”, relató el atacante, que describió su fichaje como una operación ‘secreta’ resuelta en apenas unos días y en la que su familia llegó a estar incomunicada –apagaron los móviles- para evitar llamadas inoportunas. La presencia de María y Conchín en el acto no era casual. Tres meses antes, tras marcar el primer gol de la victoria del Levante ante el Mallorca en la denominada 'final por la permanencia', Carlos Espí había subido las escaleras de la grada del Ciutat para abrazarlas. Aquel día confesó que había tenido que insistir para convencerlas de acudir al estadio y después pidió expresamente hacerse una fotografía con ellas, una a cada lado, con el fondo del coliseo granota detrás. La imagen tomada en el mes de mayo ilustraba el peso que tiene la familia en la trayectoria del delantero de Tavernes de la Valldigna. Entonces contaba en Radio MARCA que sus abuelas sufrían más por las patadas que recibía que por los resultados y bromeaba con la exigencia de María, capaz de recordarle las ocasiones falladas incluso después de marcar. Desde entonces, la vida de Espí ha cambiado a velocidad de vértigo. Su explosión goleadora en la segunda vuelta ayudó al Levante a alcanzar la permanencia y llamó la atención de varios clubes hasta que el Real Madrid decidió apostar por él pagando el importe de su cláusula. Con apenas 21 años, pasó de ser una de las revelaciones del campeonato a convertirse en refuerzo del nuevo proyecto dirigido por José Mourinho. Y el estreno no pudo ser mejor. Apenas unas horas antes de su presentación oficial, Espí debutó en Liga con la camiseta blanca marcando el gol de la victoria ante el Espanyol en el minuto 90, dando al Real Madrid un triunfo por 1-2 en el estreno liguero del equipo de Mourinho. El delantero apareció desde el banquillo para resolver un partido que se había complicado y confirmar que la confianza depositada en él tenía recompensa inmediata. Entre el abrazo con sus abuelas en el Ciutat de València y la fotografía con ellas en su presentación en Valdebebas apenas han transcurrido tres meses. En ese corto espacio de tiempo, Carlos Espí ha pasado de ser el héroe inesperado de la salvación granota a convertirse en jugador del Real Madrid. Todavía quedan muchas páginas por escribir para el delantero valenciano. Pero de momento está demostrando muy buen ojo para elegir sus mejores recuerdos en forma de foto.

articles.title: Carlos Baleba joins Manchester United in transfer from Brighton
articles.summary: Cameroon midfielder joins EPL powerhouse for a fee understood to be worth up to 70 million pounds.
articles.body:
Manchester United have signed Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba from fellow English Premier League club Brighton.

The 22-year-old is the third midfielder signed by the Red Devils during the summer transfer window.

“Manchester United is pleased to confirm that Carlos Baleba has joined the club, subject to registration,” the 20-time Premier League champions said in a statement on Tuesday.

United said Baleba signed a deal until 2031 with the option to extend for a further year, but it did not disclose the value.

It is understood that Brighton had been holding out for a deal worth $100m although United are believed to have agreed a 70-million-pound ($95m) transfer fee, which takes their spending on midfield reinforcements to more than 150 million pounds ($204m) in this window.

Baleba was born in Douala, Cameroon, but started his professional career in 2022 with French Ligue 1 side Lille. The next year, he joined Brighton, where he made 79 starts and registered more than 100 appearances for the Seagulls.

United had been linked with a move for Baleba, who plays in a defensive role in midfield, last summer and again in the January transfer window.

Baleba, who follows fellow midfielders Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos to Old Trafford this summer, has made 16 appearances for Cameroon.

“Baleba has already established himself as one of the most talented midfielders in the Premier League,” United’s statement said.

“During the 2024/25 season, his combined number of tackles and interceptions was the sixth-highest among midfielders in the league, while he also ranked fourth-highest for progressive ball carries per 90 minutes.

“Last season, Baleba played 31 games in the Premier League, ranking in the top eight per cent of players for combined tackles and interceptions as well as the top one per cent for second balls won, helping Brighton & Hove Albion to qualify for the UEFA Conference League.”

The trio of midfield signings by United will help to fill the gap left by Brazil’s former Real Madrid star Casemiro, who has joined Major League Soccer side Inter Miami in the United States.

“It is an incredible feeling to join the club of my dreams,” Baleba said.

“Playing at Old Trafford is always special, but the opportunity to do so as a Manchester United player will be a real honour.

“I cannot wait to work with Michael Carrick. His experience and knowledge of the game make him the perfect coach to help me to reach the highest level.”

articles.title: Tennessee LB Arion Carter's Suspension Over $427 Flight Reduced by NCAA
articles.summary: Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter had his suspension regarding a flight payment reduced to one game by the NCAA, Volunteers athletic director Danny White announced Tuesday.
articles.body:
Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter had his suspension regarding a flight payment reduced to one game by the NCAA, Volunteers athletic director Danny White announced Tuesday.

Carter initially received a two-game suspension on July 29 after his agent paid $427 for a flight to an NFL training facility during the offseason. He later paid the agent back for the flight.

The NCAA originally suspended Carter three games for the Level III violation before the Volunteers appealed the penalty and had it reduced, according to ESPN's Mark Schlabach .

The 21-year-old played through a foot injury near the end of last season and declared for the 2026 NFL draft in Dec. 2025, but ultimately returned to Tennessee after aggravating the injury and undergoing surgery.

Carter is expected to be a key piece of a deep Volunteers linebacking corps that includes Amare Campbell, Edwin Spillman and Jeremiah Telander.

In 10 games last season, Carter racked up 76 tackles, six tackles for loss, two passes defended, 1.5 sacks and one forced fumble.

Tennessee is looking to remain a threat in the SEC during its 2026 campaign after recording double-digit win totals in two of the past four years.

While Carter will still miss the Volunteers' season-opening clash with Furman on Sept. 5, he'll now be available to suit up during a matchup with Georgia Tech on Sept. 12.

articles.title: 5-Star OT Austin Attalah Announces CFB Commitment Between Texas, Texas Tech, USC
articles.summary: The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.
articles.body:
The college football season kicks off this week, but Texas Tech has already scored a win thanks to top offensive tackle recruit Austin Attalah.

Attalah told Hayes Fawcett of Rivals.com on Tuesday that he will join the Red Raiders as part of their 2028 recruiting class. The California native picked Texas Tech over Texas and USC.

247Sports' composite rankings have Attalah rated as a 5-star prospect, the third-best offensive tackle and No. 27 overall recruit in 2028.

In his scouting evaluation of Attalah for 247Sports, Gabe Brooks described his hand work and punch power as "works in progress" but the ceiling is that of a "high-major tackle who could become a pro prospect."

Attalah's commitment is yet another recruiting win for head coach Joey McGuire. Texas Tech has been among the best programs in the nation at landing new talent over the past two years.

The 2025 season saw the Red Raiders finish with the No. 2 transfer portal class in the country thanks to additions like David Bailey and Romello Height.

That group helped catapult Texas Tech to a 12-2 record, its first double-digit win season since 2008 and its first-ever Big 12 title. The team made the College Football Playoff as the No. 4 seed, but lost its first playoff game to Oregon in the quarterfinal.

McGuire and his staff have been able to carry that momentum over into 2026 and beyond. The incoming freshman class this year is ranked 15th nationally, led by 5-star tackle Felix Ojo.

It's still very early in the 2028 recruiting cycle, but Attalah is one of two players the Red Raiders have landed thus far. The other is punter Luc Normand.

Texas Tech will open this season ranked No. 12 in the Associated Press Top 25 poll, its highest spot in the preseason poll since 2008. The Red Raiders will open the year against Abilene Christian on Sept. 5.

articles.title: 'I was not a good national team coach': Manolo Marquez
articles.summary: Football News: MUMBAI: Manolo Marquez has admitted he was ânot a good national team coachâ during his brief stint with India, accepting responsibility for a disappoi.
articles.body: MUMBAI: Manolo Marquez has admitted he was ânot a good national team coachâ during his brief stint with India, accepting responsibility for a disappointing run while arguing that structural issues in Indian football made the job even more difficult.In his 11 months in charge of the Indian national team, a post he left a year ago, India won one of eight matches, and it was a friendly against the low-ranked Maldives.Marquez, who is beginning his seventh season in India and his third ISL club assignment with Mumbai City FC, was blunt when asked what he learnt from his time as India coach.âI think that the results were bad. I was not a good national team coach,â he said. âWhen you play eight games, and you win only one, itâs not good. I called 51 players in eight games, which is too much. I never found the correct group.âThe Spaniard, however, believes his record cannot be viewed in isolation. He pointed to the disparity between India and several of their Asian opponents, particularly the increasing presence of overseas-born or foreign-origin players in rival national teams.âWhen you donât play with the same conditions, the opponent is very difficult,â he said.Marquez also recalled the impact of players such as Ryan Williams, who scored for India shortly after being introduced, and Hamza Choudhury, whose presence transformed Bangladesh.But the former FC Goa coach was clear that he would not use those factors to escape responsibility.âI am the first person guilty, and I donât want to avoid responsibility,â he said. âThere are a lot of factors, but one factor was that I was not the correct person in that moment.âMarquez also revealed that despite widespread reports, he had no difficulty combining his India role with his responsibilities at FC Goa, saying he had been caught between criticism that he was prioritising the club and criticism that he was not doing enough for the national team.His wider diagnosis of Indian football was equally stark. The 58-year-old believes the biggest issue lies in how players are prepared before they reach the professional level.âFor me, the problem is in how they arrive. Most of them arrive without the correct knowledge in professional football,â he said.Marquez feels the gap in professionalism between Indian players and those from established football nations remains significant, pointing to nutrition, training, recovery, sleep and strength conditioning as areas that need improvement.âObviously, the attitude to get better is there. But still, I think that we need to improve in some very important aspects. I think that most of the Indian players go to the gym, but I'm not sure that most of the players know what the correct thing to do at the gym is. So you get my point,â he said.He also believes foreigners remain decisive in the ISL. Last season, teams operated with differing numbers of overseas players, with East Bengal and Mohun Bagan winning the top two positions while Mumbai, despite using fewer foreigners, emerged as the strongest side operating with four.âThe foreigners are the difference in Indian football,â Marquez said. âBut obviously, the level of the Indian players is very important. articles.title: El Cádiz ficha a Jandro Orellana hasta 2030
articles.standfirst: El mediocentro, con experiencia en Segunda división, procede del Estoril Praia portugués
articles.summary: El mediocentro, con experiencia en Segunda división, procede del Estoril Praia portugués
articles.body: El Cádiz ha hecho oficial el fichaje de Jandro Orellana. El club amarillo ha alcanzado un acuerdo con el Estoril Praia para el traspaso del mediocentro catalán, que firma hasta junio de 2030 y ya trabaja bajo las órdenes de Albert Celades. Nacido en Gavá el 7 de agosto de 2000, Orellana llega al Nuevo Mirandilla con experiencia tanto en Segunda como en la máxima categoría portuguesa. Se formó en las categorías inferiores del Espanyol y el Barcelona antes de iniciar su trayectoria en el fútbol profesional. En 2022 firmó por el Andorra, donde permaneció durante dos temporadas y disputó 61 partidos en LaLiga Hypermotion. Dos años después fue traspasado al Estoril, con el que acumuló otros 42 encuentros en la primera división de Portugal. A sus 26 años, Orellana aumenta las alternativas de Celades en el centro del campo y se convierte en una apuesta de largo recorrido para el Cádiz. Su conocimiento de la categoría debería facilitar su adaptación a un equipo que ha apostado por rejuvenecer su plantilla y dar protagonismo a futbolistas con margen de crecimiento. El mediocentro ya se encuentra integrado en la dinámica del conjunto amarillo y podría entrar próximamente en los planes del entrenador. El Cádiz incorpora así experiencia, recorrido y competencia para una de las zonas que buscaba reforzar antes del cierre del mercado.

articles.title: Bruno Fernandes told to âkeep your mouth shutâ by Man United legend Paul Scholes after criticising team despite poor display
articles.summary: Football News: Manchester United legend Paul Scholes criticizes Bruno Fernandes for publicly calling out the team's performance after their opening-day loss to Hull City, highlighting issues of accountability and team dynamics.
articles.body: Manchester United's opening-day defeat to Hull City has already sparked a furious reaction from club legend Paul Scholes, who has questioned Bruno Fernandes' decision to publicly criticise his own team's performance.United began the Premier League season with a 2-0 defeat at the MKM Stadium on Saturday, conceding twice from set pieces in a result that immediately raised questions about Michael Carrick's side. Fernandes was among the players to speak afterwards, but his assessment of the performance has now come under fire from Scholes.Scholes takes aim at Fernandes' post-match commentsFernandes did not hide his frustration after the defeat, pointing specifically to problems that he felt had carried over from last season's away performances.The United captain said his side had made the âsame mistakes as we did last seasonâ, particularly in the way they allowed Hull to have possession early in the match.âEvery away game we give too much of the ball to them,â Fernandes said. âIn the first 20 minutes, the goalkeeper was the one with the most touches.âHe argued that United needed to press with greater intensity and be more aggressive, while also addressing their inability to defend set pieces.âWe needed to press more, be more aggressive, and then again we need to work on set plays and not concede these types of goals,â Fernandes added. âAgainst these types of teams, they are waiting for that moment.âBut Scholes was unimpressed by the captain's assessment, particularly given his own performance in the match.Speaking on The Good, The Bad & The Football podcast, Scholes questioned exactly what Fernandes meant by the mistakes he was referring to before delivering his blunt verdict.âEspecially when you perform the way he did as well, I think it's probably best to keep your mouth shut,â Scholes said. âHe didn't have his best performance either.âFernandes' criticism was made more conspicuous by his own performance statistics. He gave the ball away 22 times during the 90 minutes against Hull, with Luke Shaw the only United player losing possession more often, at 23.Scholes says the comments could undermine CarrickScholes' criticism did not stop with Fernandes.The former United midfielder and fellow former player Dion Dublin also discussed comments made by Luke Shaw, who similarly suggested that United had not prepared properly for Hull's set-piece threat.Shaw said: âItâs not us and we knew it was coming. I think as a whole, as a group, collectively, we could prepare better. Especially knowing how good they are at set plays and what their dangers are.âFor Scholes, that was not simply an admission of poor performance, it potentially reflected badly on the coaching staff and Carrick.âLuke Shaw always says something. And that's a slight on your staff. That's a slight on your manager,â Scholes said. âIf one of your players is saying that you'd be like f*ing hell, you'd have them in on Monday morning.âDublin agreed that players needed to be careful about what they said publicly after a performance like that.âYou want silence. If your skipper has to speak then he has to speak, but then you make sure he says the things that don't open a can of worms,â Dublin said. âYou just don't give anyone any ammunition because the ammunition is there from your performance.âScholes then drew on his own experience under Sir Alex Ferguson, arguing that similar comments during his playing days would have had consequences.âThose comments are not so much about respect but you speak about fear of managers and the things they've said, they're a slight on the manager and staff,â he said. âAs a player if we did that about Sir Alex, âwe weren't preparedâ, f*ing hell, you'd be right in and he'd probably single you out in front of the full team.âFernandes' criticism came after a miserable United displayThe backdrop to the argument is a result that could hardly have been more damaging to United's opening-day optimism.Newly promoted Hull restricted United's attacking threat before punishing them at the other end, with Semi Ajayi opening the scoring from a corner before Nobel Mendy doubled the advantage from a free-kick before half-time.The 2-0 victory gave Hull three points in their first top-flight match since the 2016/17 season, while United were left to reflect on a performance in which they struggled both to create chances and deal with a threat Fernandes himself had identified beforehand.That disconnect appears to be what particularly irritated Scholes: the captain's comments highlighted problems that were plainly visible, but came after Fernandes himself had failed to deliver a strong individual performance.United now have to respondThe defeat leaves Carrick with plenty to address before United's next Premier League fixture.United return to action on Sunday when they host another promoted side, Ipswich Town, with the pressure already beginning to build around a team that entered the campaign with considerably greater expectations than the opening weekend suggested.For Fernandes, the immediate challenge is to turn his own frustration into a response on the pitch. For Carrick, it is to ensure that the criticism from his captain and Shaw does not become evidence of deeper problems inside the dressing room.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Liam Delap: Nottingham Forest agree £50m deal for Chelsea striker
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest have agreed a fee worth around £50m to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap.
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record fee worth around £50m to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap.

The 23-year-old is expected to undergo a medical and sign a long-term contract at the City Ground this week.

Delap's move comes a year after he joined Chelsea from Ipswich Town for £30m amid competition from Manchester United and Everton .

However, Chelsea made him available for sale this summer after he scored just one Premier League goal in a previous campaign disrupted by shoulder and hamstring injuries.

Forest have already signed defender Ousmane Diomande from Sporting for £34m, alongside free agents, Austrian midfielder Xaver Schlager and goalkeeper Steve Benda.

They sold England midfielder Elliot Anderson to Manchester City for a club-record £116m and striker Taiwo Awoniyi to Coventry City for £9m.

Delap's arrival would provide competition for strikers Chris Wood and Igor Jesus, who failed to find the target in Forest's 1-0 defeat by Leeds in their home Premier League opener on Saturday.

Chelsea have also signed two strikers this summer in Emmanuel Emegha from Strasbourg and Danny Welbeck from Brighton .

Delap came up through Derby County's youth system before joining Manchester City in 2019.

After helping City win the FA Youth Cup in the 2019-20 campaign, he scored 24 goals in 20 Premier League 2 matches in 2020-21 as they won the title.

In September 2020 the striker scored on his senior City debut in a 2-1 League Cup win against Bournemouth , and three days later made his Premier League debut in a 5-2 defeat by Leicester.

Injuries played a part in limiting further first-team opportunities, and between 2022 and 2024 Delap spent time on loan in the Championship with Stoke, Preston North End and Hull City .

In the summer of 2024 he was sold for £20m by City to Ipswich and scored 12 goals in 37 Premier League games for the newly promoted side.

articles.summary: Vuelve cedido por el Milan con opción de compra
articles.body: El Leipzig acaba de confirmar la vuelta de uno de los futbolistas que se convirtió en ídolo en el Red Bull Arena, Christopher Nkunku. El francés llega en calidad de cedido para jugar esta temporada, aunque tiene opción de compra en caso de convencer a los alemanes con su rendimiento. Se convirtió en su momento en una de las mayores venta del Leipzig. En en 2019 llegó por menos de 20 millones de euros y aportó 70 goles y 56 asistencias en 172 partidos, ganando por el camino dos Copas y el trofeo a máximo goleador de la Bundesliga en la 22/23 (empatado con Füllkrug). Cuatro años después, el Chelsea pagó por él 60 millones de euros.  Sin embargo, nunca volvió a ser el que se vio en Alemania. Las lesiones le lastraron. A las pocas semanas de llegar a Londres, se lesionó el menisco. Varias dolencias más le privaron de ser regular en el conjunto 'blue'. Debido a la 'sobrepoblación' de la plantilla, tuvo que salir traspasado al Milan el pasado verano, donde ha visto puerta ocho ocasiones en 35 encuentros. Este año, no contaba para Ruben Amorim, nuevo entrenador del cuadro italiano, por lo que ha decidido regresar cedido al lugar donde mostró su mejor versión. Un Leipzig falto de gol. La temporada pasada fue el equipo de los clasificados a Champions de la liga alemana que menos tantos metieron. Solo Baumgartner y Diomandé superaron las 10 anotaciones, y el costamarfileño ya no está, por lo que la llegada de Nkunku puede suponer un gran movimiento.

There has been a gap in valuation between the two clubs throughout the summer, with PSG asking for around £145m for the France international.

However, the discussions that have taken place during this window have been described as positive, and there is optimism that a deal can be struck with a week left before the deadline.

Sky Sports News understands there are good relations between the two clubs at the highest level. It is hoped this will help Liverpool and PSG reach an agreement.

Liverpool have also explored a move for Barcola's team-mate, Ibrahim Mbaye , who plays off the right wing.

The Premier League club's priority throughout this window has been to reinforce in wide areas.

They have been pursuing Barcola and Mbaye, while Brighton have also rejected two Liverpool offers for Yankuba Minteh , the latest being £60m.

Liverpool are currently the only club chasing Barcola, who has entered the final two years of his deal and has grown dissatisfied with his role at the European champions.

Liverpool, meanwhile, do not want to sell Cody Gakpo amid interest from Tottenham and Manchester City and would likely need two new wingers in before considering letting the Netherlands international go.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Reacts to 'Villain' Label After Recruiting NFL's Dae'Quan Wright, Zxavian Harris to LSU
articles.summary: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin isn't concerned with labels as he tries to restore his team to national championship contention.
articles.body:
LSU head coach Lane Kiffin isn't concerned with labels as he tries to restore his team to national championship contention.

During an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show on Tuesday, Kiffin was asked about the "villain" label he's received since landing commitments from former Cleveland Browns tight end Dae'Quan Wright and former New Orleans Saints defensive end Zxavian Harrison."

"I don't worry too much about that," Kiffin replied. "I think as you talk about villains, sometimes the difference between the hero and the villain isn't very far apart, and it changes very often. ... When you're trying to do things at the highest level, a lot of times people want you to apologize for what you're doing when you're chasing greatness."

According to the Associated Press , Wright was among a group of athletes who filed a lawsuit in Louisiana seeking a fifth year of college eligibility for members of the high school class of 2022. The court issued a temporary restraining order that paved the way for him and others to return to college athletics.

Kiffin noted on Tuesday that he's not the only coach who is trying to make use of the loopholes in the NCAA's eligibility rules.

Kiffin went on to add that while he understands the concerns about professional athletes trying to gain advantages by returning to college, he feels that doesn't apply to this situation because of the specific circumstances surrounding the 2022 class' chances of a fifth year of eligibility.

"There's a lot of parts that I don't like within that. I don't think professionals should come back to college sports and college football, particularly," Kiffin said. "But in this instance, this is not professionals that have gone and played seasons or just randomly filed an injunction in a state to become eligible. This is part of a specific class that was ruled wronged by the NCAA that was supposed to be five for five."

Still, the situation undoubtedly creates more questions than answers in the ever-changing landscape of college sports, so it will be interesting to see how the NCAA responds going forward.

articles.body: Armando González ya logró cumplir el objetivo de llegar al futbol de Europa tras su buena temporada con el Guadalajara en el curso anterior, desempeño que lo llevó al Mundial 2026 con la Selección Mexicana. El delantero completó el traspaso pese a su mal arranque en la nueva campaña, donde se fue de Chivas sin marcar en seis partidos entre el Apertura 2026 y la Leagues Cup. Su último gol fue en abril. El acuerdo con Chivas se dio tras una oferta de 8.5 millones de euros más 2 millones más en variables por el 90 por ciento de la carta del jugador, según información del periodista griego Nikos Kotsis. Esa cifra total de 10.5MDE lo convierte en el traspaso más caro para el club griego desde la temporada 1999-2000, cuando contrataron a Zlatko Zahovic por 13.5 millones desde el Porto y a Giovanni, del Barcelona, por 12MDE. Desde entonces nadie ha rebasado los 9 millones de euros y con el dueño actual, Evangelos Marinakis, que compró al club en 2010, este verano se pagó por el mexicano y por David Carmo, defensa, 9MDE. *Se pagan 8.5 fijos y 2 millones en variables Fuente: Transfermarkt Durante el fin de semana Armando González estuvo en El Pireo y asistió al partido que el Olympiacos le ganó 1-0 al Atromitos, con gol de David Carmo en los minutos finales. Presente en el Estadio Georgios Karaiskakis, su nueva casa, el mexicano tuvo contacto con el duelo del equipo, Vangelis Marinakis, quien le habrñia pedido entregar el máximo para apoyar al equipo rojiblanco a alcanzar los objetivos de la temporada. Se espera que Hormiga pueda debutar el próximo domingo cuando el equipo visite al Asteras en Tripolis, donde milita el también mexicano Jordan Silva, defensa que jugara en Toluca, Tijuana, Cruz Azul, América, Querétaro y San Luis en Liga MX.

articles.body: El Celta hizo oficial este martes su quinta incorporación cara a la presente temporada. Couhaib Driouech firma por el club vigués por cuatro temporadas, hasta junio de 2030. articles.title: Liam Delap transfer: Nottingham Forest agree club-record deal to sign Chelsea striker
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record £50m deal to sign Liam Delap from Chelsea; striker moved to Stamford Bridge last summer, but scored just two goals in 41 games for the club; Chelsea could make a £20m profit having signed the 23-year-old for £30m
articles.body:
The transfer is understood to be worth at least £45m, which could reach £50m with add-ons.

The striker is scheduled to have a medical on Wednesday.

Delap had interest from a number of other Premier League clubs, including Everton, but Forest have secured his signing.

Chelsea signed Delap last summer for £30m from Ipswich and valued him at around £50m this summer.

They could be set for a £20m profit on a striker who scored two goals in 41 appearances last season.

Forest's previous record transfer saw Omari Hutchison join for £37.5m from Ipswich Town in August 2025.

Tim Sherwood speaking on Soccer Special:

"We know Liam's got the ability; he's shown that in the past. He needs to play on a regular basis now. He needs to stay fit.

"It never worked out at Chelsea. I never think he ever got a run in the team to give that striker the confidence; you need the manager to love you and play you every week, even if you're not playing well. I think he'll get that with Glasner - you've seen that with (Jean-Philippe Mateta) at Palace.

"He [Forest boss Oliver Glasner] likes to play with a big striker; he likes support. If he [Delap] can keep up with play, I think he'll score goals for Nottingham Forest, and I believe he will keep up with play.

"I think he's aggressive; he's got a lot of attributes to be a top, top striker, but Chelsea just did not work for him, and that's what happens.

"Forget about the price tag because the price tags all over the Premier League now are just ridiculous."

Forest are bringing in Delap to improve their striking options following Taiwo Awoniyi's £9m move to Coventry.

Oliver Glasner's side have been pursuing Tottenham midfielder Lucas Bergvall as an Elliot Anderson replacement, but Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi insists he is staying in north London.

Forest could also add a right wing-back, with Dodo at Fiorentina a player of interest.

Dilane Bakwa is set to join Lille on loan, while centre-backs Zach Abbott and Tyler Bindon could also depart on temporary moves amid interest from Watford.

articles.body: Panaji: Itâs the worst kept secret in Indian football.A majority of the clubs in top tier Indian Super League (ISL) are known to be way above the salary cap of Rs 16.5 crore. Besides a standard player contract, clubs sign bonus letters, image rights agreement and have other arrangements, which includes employment in parent companies, to stay within the salary cap.Yet, all these years, no club has been pulled up for flouting the salary cap. Thereâs been rules in place âaction/sanction by the league which includes fine and/or deduction of points,â but clubs donât care, simply because nobody has bothered with the implementation.Now, the All India Football Federation (AIFF) has made it mandatory for all clubs to upload side letters and allied contractual documents, alongside player employment contracts, on the Centralised Registration System (CRS). The mandatory uploading of all accompanying documents and side letters will strictly apply to all transactions registered during the ongoing transfer window from June 1 to August 31, 2026.âAny failure, suppression, concealment or omission by a club to upload complete contractual documents and side letters on the CRS shall be deemed a violation of the AIFF regulations and procedural norms, rendering the concerned entity subject to appropriate disciplinary proceedings and sanctions,â AIFF deputy secretary general M Satyanarayan wrote to all state associations on Sunday.Satyanarayan said the circular is being issued pursuant to a recent decision of the AIFF players' status committee in the matter of Sahil Tavora vs Jindal Football Pvt Ltd, who took over Hyderabad FC and later renamed it to Sporting Club Delhi.According to the PSC, it was discovered upon verification that Tavoraâs FC Goa Employment Agreement was uploaded on the CRS, whereas the corresponding FC Goa Image Rights Agreement -- â worth Rs 65 lakh for two years â had not been uploaded.Tavora also did not make any mention of the separate image rights agreement while pursuing his dues from Hyderabad FC. His lawyer contended that the FC Goa Image Rights Agreement should not be considered for the purpose of mitigation, as the payments do not fall within the definition of âremunerationâ under Article 20.âThe committee is unable to accept this submission,â PSC chairperson Justice Ravindra Singh noted in his order last week. âThe committee notes that the Side Letter, Player Bonus Agreement(s) executed between Hyderabad FC and the player were taken into account as part of the playerâs contractual remuneration for determining his claim. Accordingly, the player cannot selectively contend that one contractual benefit should be considered for determining his entitlement, while another contractual benefit should be excluded when assessing his mitigation.âSignificantly, PSC rejected and dismissed the claim instituted by Tavora.Salary cap is the maximum expenditure a club is permitted to spend on player signings. It includes individual performance bonus (exclusive of team bonus), agent/intermediary fees and separate arrangements with players.According to the League rules, salary cap is âneeded to maintain a healthy competitive balance.âGet the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Julian Alvarez transfer latest: Atletico standing firm on Barcelona as Arsenal become only get out for Argentine striker
articles.summary: Julian Alvarez is holding out for a move to Barcelona, but Atletico Madrid are standing firm on the refusal to sell to their LaLiga rivals; Atletico football expert Ruben Uría believes the only way out for Alvarez is to join Premier League champions Arsenal
articles.body:
Atletico have told him again that they will not sell him to Barcelona and that - coupled with the reaction of the club's supporters on Sunday - has left him "devastated", according to well-placed sources in Spain.

The situation is now "extremely tense", according to Atletico expert and journalist Ruben Uría.

"Neither Miguel Gil Marín (CEO of Atlético Madrid) nor the Apollo board want to sell the player to Barcelona," he told Sky Sports News . "The entire Apollo board supports Gil Marín's decision. Alvarez has been told."

According to Uría, Arsenal sporting director Andrea Berta has remained in contact with his former Atletico employers in recent days after Alvarez was booed off by supporters in the opening LaLiga game against Villarreal.

But Arsenal will need Alvarez to put Barcelona out of his mind and show he really wants to join Mikel Arteta's project before any serious negotiations or any offers can be made. In that vein, Arsenal are not currently hopeful of getting him in before September 1 and they are certainly not currently expecting it at the Emirates.

Alvarez still has his heart set on Barcelona. The question is, will this be the case as the transfer window comes to an end? Will the deadline have any effect? Arsenal will always be ready and open to Alvarez should he change his mind but, at the moment, any move looks very unlikely.

If Alvarez shifts his thinking before the end and pushes for an escape, Atletico are believed to be ready to listen to offers of around £130m (€150m) from Arsenal. Indeed, according to Uría, some people around the Argentine think it is increasingly impossible for him to stay at Atletico given the current atmosphere.

Should Arsenal complete a deal for Alvarez, it would be the 10th £100m+ signing in Premier League history.

It would also be the fourth this summer, after Morgan Rogers ' switch to Chelsea, Elliot Anderson 's move to Manchester City and Sandro Tonali joining Tottenham.

Uría also told Sky Sports News : "Julian and his agent believe that everything that's happening is the fault of Gil Marín, Atletico Madrid's CEO, who publicly asked them to say they wanted to leave Atletico.

"For their part, Atletico Madrid argues that Julian already knew how Atletico played under Diego Simeone when he signed for the club, that he knew what contract he was signing and what its clause was, and they deny that Atletico told him he could leave for a direct rival.

"We are waiting to see how events unfold regarding Julian, waiting to see how Arsenal reacts, and if they have genuine interest in the Argentina player. Atletico Madrid will not sell to Barcelona.

"Our information today is that the Julian Alvarez situation has become very tense, and according to several reliable sources, right now, in this crucial week, there are only two paths: stay at Atletico Madrid to fulfil his contract or listen to Arsenal's offer and sign for the London club. Julian will have to make his decision."
authors: Ruben Uría, Lyall Thomas & Rob Dorsett

articles.title: La propiedad del Valladolid inyecta 14 millones para aumentar el límite salarial: "Sin esto, el club no sería viable"
articles.standfirst: La acción fue aprobada en Junta General Extraordinaria de Accionistas
articles.summary: La acción fue aprobada en Junta General Extraordinaria de Accionistas
articles.body: El Real Valladolid aprobó en Junta General Extraordinaria, celebrada este martes en el José Zorrilla, la inyección de 14 millones de euros por parte de Ignite Sports y Ben Oldman, accionistas mayoritarios del club blanquivioleta. Esto se realiza a través de un préstamo participativo que se devolverá en un futuro con una ampliación de capital o vía ingresos de utilidad. El objetivo es garantizar la viabilidad de la entidad y aumentar el límite salarial de los 4 a los 11 millones. El presidente, Gabriel Solares, dejó clara la importancia de la acción: "Nos permite seguir respirando. Era esto o que el Real Valladolid no fuera viable. Sin esta inyección económica, la plantilla sería la de la temporada pasada y no se hubiera podido inscribir ni fichar a nadie. Estamos reconstruyendo el club desde lo más básico, los cimientos. Queremos que sea la última vez de un nuevo inicio". Todo ello, tras el devastador paso de Ronaldo Nazario por la entidad pucelana. Además, el mexicano reconoció que el inicio de la campaña deportiva, con dos derrotas, ha sido "malo", aunque se muestra optimista para el futuro: "Existen conexiones de conocimiento entre jugadores que requieren tiempo. Me gustaron los primeros 60 minutos en Mallorca y los primeros 45 en Eibar. Hay mimbres para hacer cosas positivas".

articles.title: Corberán espera a Arnau Martínez cuanto antes en Valencia
articles.standfirst: Acuerdo con el Girona para el traspaso del lateral derecho que pasará la revisión médica este miércoles
articles.summary: Acuerdo con el Girona para el traspaso del lateral derecho que pasará la revisión médica este miércoles
articles.body: El Valencia y el Girona ya han alcanzado un acuerdo para el traspaso de Arnau Martínez, una operación que, a falta de los últimos trámites administrativos y de la correspondiente revisión médica, permitirá al lateral catalán convertirse en nuevo jugador valencianista para las próximas cinco temporadas. La entidad de Mestalla llevaba semanas trabajando en la incorporación del defensa de 23 años, una de las prioridades de Carlos Corberán para reforzar la línea defensiva. Tras varias ofertas rechazadas, el club valenciano consiguió acercar posturas con el Girona mediante una propuesta de cinco millones de euros fijos, un millón adicional en variables y un porcentaje de una futura venta del futbolista. La intención del Valencia es cerrar toda la documentación en las próximas horas para que Arnau pueda incorporarse cuanto antes a la dinámica del equipo. La previsión es que el jugador viaje a Valencia en las próximas horas para superar el reconocimiento médico y firmar un contrato hasta junio de 2031. La llegada de Arnau supone una noticia muy positiva para Corberán, que había insistido en la necesidad de incorporar a un lateral derecho que fuera capaz de actuar también como central, de manera circunstancial Esa polivalencia, y la reciente lesión de Justin de Haas para alrededor de un mes, ha sido uno de los factores que más han influido para que el Valencia suba su oferta hasta unos términos que han convencido al Girona. Formado en la cantera del Barcelona y asentado posteriormente en el Girona, Arnau Martínez ha acumulado experiencia en la élite del fútbol español. Con esta incorporación, el Valencia suma su séptimo refuerzo para el curso 2026-27 y atiende una de las principales demandas de Corberán en el mercado de verano. La prioridad del técnico es contar con Arnau lo antes posible para comenzar a integrarlo en los entrenamientos para preparar el próximo partido de Liga ante el Deportivo.

articles.title: Former Man Utd star and pundit warns Neymar-Messi reunion will turn MLS into âeven more of a circusâ in scathing attack
articles.summary: Football News: Giuseppe Rossi warns that Neymar's potential transfer to Inter Miami for a reunion with Messi and Suarez could make MLS 'even more of a circus' while failing to address the league's competitive issues.
articles.body: Neymar's potential move to Inter Miami has been framed as the perfect opportunity for another reunion with Lionel Messi and Luis Suarez, but one former Premier League and Serie A forward believes the move could expose a bigger problem within Major League Soccer.Giuseppe Rossi, the former Manchester United and Villarreal forward who is now Head of Soccer at the New York Cosmos, has warned that bringing Neymar to MLS would be excellent entertainment and marketing, but would do little to improve the quality of football being played in the competition.The Brazilian has been repeatedly linked with a move to Miami, where he could reunite with Messi and Suarez after their hugely successful spell together at Barcelona. For Rossi, however, the question is not whether supporters would want to watch it. It is whether another superstar reunion is actually helping MLS become a stronger football league.Rossi questions what MLS is trying to becomeRossi made his comments while speaking to GOAL in an interview conducted in association with BetBrothers, and he was particularly critical of the league's continued reliance on globally famous players to generate attention.MLS has undergone a major transformation through marquee arrivals over the years, with David Beckham, Steven Gerrard, Kaka, Andrea Pirlo, Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Wayne Rooney among the established stars who have moved to the United States.Messi's arrival in 2023 took that strategy to another level, with the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner becoming the league's biggest attraction. Inter Miami subsequently surrounded him with several former Barcelona team-mates, including Suarez, Sergio Busquets and Jordi Alba, while Rodrigo De Paul and Casemiro have also joined the club.Neymar could now become the latest superstar to make the move, with his Santos contract due to expire at the end of the year.But Rossi believes MLS risks becoming too focused on the attention generated by those names.âThis is where MLS are making mistakes, and they continue to make these mistakes. Itâs great marketing, it is what it is, but what kind of product are you putting on the field?â Rossi told GOAL.He specifically questioned the idea of bringing Neymar to Miami simply to recreate the famous Barcelona attack.âBringing Neymar back to reunite him with Lionel Messi and Luis Suarez, what are you trying to become as a league?ââYouâre moving at a snailâs paceâRossi's concern is not that MLS has failed commercially. Quite the opposite.He acknowledged the league's substantial growth and the increasing value of its clubs, but argued that the sporting product has not developed at the same rate.âIf itâs to get to the level of the big boys out in Europe like the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga and those competitions, youâre moving at a snailâs pace but MLS is very thirsty for clicks and views, and they donât really care about the standard of the football itself,â he said.Rossi went on to distinguish between the league's commercial success and its footballing development.âYes, they have made great strides, and well done to them for that. The valuations of the clubs are high and itâs a great business model but what about the football? Is that growing and moving forward? I donât think so, and thatâs something that has to change.âHe believes the underlying issue comes from the priorities of those running the competition.âThe problem is that the people in charge donât really care. They only care about the valuations. Thatâs the problem when you put these billionaires in charge of a league.âIn Rossi's view, Neymar would therefore be an attractive commercial addition without necessarily addressing the competitive development he believes MLS needs.âTheyâd love to see Neymar come to MLS and play with Messi again but itâs not going to grow MLS as a football league. Thatâs what I think.âRossi still believes Neymar could benefit from joining Messi and SuarezDespite his criticism, Rossi was not arguing that Neymar is finished as a footballer.Quite the opposite: he believes the Brazilian could still make a significant impact if he moved to Inter Miami and reunited with Messi and Suarez.Neymar, now 34, has endured a difficult period with injuries and inconsistent form since leaving European football, and his return to Santos has not produced the sustained revival many expected.But Rossi remains convinced that the player retains the ability to make the move worthwhile on an individual level.âIf Neymar could make the move to Miami, why not? It would be great for him, and heâs still a great player. I freaking love Neymar,â Rossi told GOAL.He added that Neymar remains âone of the best players of his generationâ and that supporters would naturally want to see him back alongside Messi and Suarez.That is precisely where Rossi sees the contradiction: the reunion could be fantastic for the players, the supporters and the headlines, while simultaneously doing little to address what he sees as MLS's sporting shortcomings.âI just look at it another way because there are pros and cons to everything, and yes everybody wants to see Neymar but it does take away from the integrity of the products itself by making MLS into even more of a circus than a true football league.âThe prospect of another MSN reunionNeymar, Messi and Suarez previously formed one of the most devastating attacking partnerships in modern football at Barcelona.Between 2013 and 2017, Neymar scored 105 goals and provided 76 assists in 186 appearances across all competitions for Barcelona, helping the club win eight trophies, including the 2014-15 treble.The possibility of seeing the three together again, this time in MLS, would therefore carry enormous global appeal.For Inter Miami, it would represent another blockbuster addition to a squad that has increasingly become a collection of some of the defining players of the modern era.For MLS, though, Rossi believes the question should go beyond whether another superstar can generate clicks, ticket sales and commercial interest.His warning is essentially about what happens after the spectacle: if the league wants to close the gap with Europe's strongest competitions, he believes improving the football itself has to matter just as much as attracting the biggest names.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.standfirst: El francés volverá a los entrenamientos con el grupo el lunes
articles.summary: El francés volverá a los entrenamientos con el grupo el lunes
articles.body: El PSG no contará en el partido contra el Lille con el Balón de Oro, Ousmane Dembélé. Como ha confirmado el club parisino, el francés tendrá unos días de descanso y volverá a entrenar con el grupo el próximo lunes. Desde que regresó del Mundial, el '10' no ha podido disputar muchos minutos. No participó en la pretemporada. Cuando se jugaron los dos primeros títulos de la campaña, tan solo jugó la primera parte en la Supercopa de Europa y la última media hora en la Supercopa francesa. En el primer partido de Ligue 1, con el PSG 2-0 abajo en el marcador, fue sustituido en el descanso. Una participación escasa, a pesar de necesitar goles, que explica la medida que ha tomado el técnico español junto a la directiva de dar descanso, a uno de sus mejores jugadores -si no el mejor-, para que vuelva a su mejor forma. Otro año más que no pisará el césped del Stade Pierre-Mauroy. La temporada pasada también se perdió el partido por lesión. El viernes será sustituido, probablemente, por el héroe del encuentro contra el Stade Rennes, Ferran Torres.

articles.title: AS Mónaco eleva la oferta a Cruz Azul por Erik Lira: Sólo hay un impedimento
articles.standfirst: Recta final en las negociaciones por el mediocampista mexicano
articles.summary: Recta final en las negociaciones por el mediocampista mexicano
articles.body: A pocos días de que cierre el mercado de traspasos en Europa, el AS Mónaco no renuncia a lanzarse por los servicios de Erik Lira, por el que han puesto una tercera oferta atractiva a Cruz Azul. Eso sí, aunque el club del Principado insista por la compra del mediocampista de la Selección Mexicana, aún hay un problema por resolver, la liberación de una plaza de extracomunitario. El club de la Ligue 1 ha mandado la mayor propuesta, hasta el momento, a la mesa de 'La Máquina', quienes han sostenido una reunión de emergencia para analizarla, así lo dio a conocer Santiago Fourcade en 'Cuadro Titular' y hoy ha sido confirmada por César Luis Merlo. De acuerdo con el periodista argentino, la oferta del AS Mónaco por Erik Lira ha subido a los 10  millones de euros, más variables; eso sí, el Cruz Azul se guardaría el 20% de una venta futura. De esta manera, recta final en las negociaciones por el mediocampista de 26 años, del cual se espera se cierre en las próximas horas, o, a más tardar, mañana; por lo que ya tendría contadas las horas en La Noria, y más, después de su rebeldía previo al partido ante Atlas para forzar su salida. Eso sí, antes de que se arregle la firma con Erik Lira, hay un problema que sigue sin solucionarse en el AS Mónaco, y es la liberación de una de las cuatro plazas de extracomunitario, por lo que ya trabajan por una de las salidas. Las más adelantada es la de Folarin Bolagun, quien ha recibido varias ofertas, en especial, del Tottenham; sin embargo, aún sin llegar a un acuerdo. Los demás lugares de no pertenecientes a la Unión Europea en el AS Mónaco son: Así, el conjunto de la Ligue 1 no podrá avanzar en la contratación de Erik Lira hasta que encuentre un cupo en la primera plantilla; aunque, tienen el 'sí' del futbolista para aterrizar al Principado, y sólo faltaría por arreglar su salida del Cruz Azul.

articles.title: PFA Awards 2026: Bruno Fernandes and Khadija Shaw win player of the year awards
articles.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes and Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw win the Professional Footballers' Associations men's and women's player of the year awards.
articles.body:
Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes and Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw have won the Professional Footballers' Associations men's and women's player of the year awards.

Both were previously named the Football Writers' Association men's and women's footballers of the year for the 2025-26 season.

Fernandes, who last season broke the record for the most assists in a single Premier League campaign with 21, is the first United player to win the award since Wayne Rooney in 2010.

It is a second win in three seasons for Shaw, who secured her third consecutive Women's Super League (WSL) golden boot with 21 goals as Man City were crowned champions.

City defender Nico O'Reilly succeeds Morgan Rogers as men's young player of the year, with the versatile 21-year-old cementing his place in the starting XI.

He contributed eight goal involvements (five goals) and nine clean sheets in 34 league outings, scoring twice, and was named player of the match as City beat Arsenal in the League Cup final.

Arsenal 's Olivia Smith retained her crown as the women's young player of the year, becoming only the second player after England international Lauren Hemp, to win the award on multiple occasions.

The Canada international, 22, scored 10 goals in all competitions after joining the Gunners for £1m last summer from Liverpool .

Individual success for record-breaker Fernandes

Although it was another trophy-less campaign for Man United, Fernandes enjoyed individual success, surpassing Kevin de Bruyne and Thierry Henry's record of 20 assists in a Premier League campaign.

Fernandes set up his side's opener on the final day of the season against Brighton – and scored their third – to finish 2025-26 with nine goals and 21 assists in 35 league outings. Man City's Rayan Cherki was the second-most prolific provider, with 12 assists.

His haul helped United finish third and secure Champions League football.

In total, the 31-year-old scored nine goals and contributed 22 assists in 37 matches in all competitions.

Fernandes, who joined the club from Sporting Lisbon in January 2020, beat Arsenal trio Gabriel Magalhaes, David Raya, and Declan Rice and Man City attackers Cherki and Erling Haaland to the award.

He is only the second Portuguese to be named player of the year, following back-to-back wins for former Man United winger Cristiano Ronaldo in 2007 and 2008.

Shaw scored 21 goals in 22 appearances as Man City clinched their second WSL title.

The Jamaica international registered hat-tricks against Aston Villa (four goals) and Tottenham and scored twice against West Ham on the final day of the season to become the first player to score 20 or more goals in three different WSL seasons.

Shaw is the first player to win three WSL golden boots, moving clear of two-time winners Vivienne Miedema and Sam Kerr.

The 29-year-old scored a further five goals, including the opener in the final, as Man City won the FA Cup.

Shaw, the third individual to win multiple PFA women's player of the year awards, joining Lucy Bronze and Fran Kirby, previously completed the PFA and FWA double following the 2023-24 campaign.

Team-mate Yui Hasegawa, Aston Villa 's Kirsty Hanson, Chelsea 's Lauren James, Man United's Jess Park, and Arsenal 's Alessia Russo were also shortlisted.

Arsenal and Man City dominate team of the year

The Premier League team of the year, as voted for by the players, was dominated by champions Arsenal and runners-up Man City.

Arsenal only conceded 27 goals last season, with that impressive record reflected in the selections of goalkeeper Raya and defenders Gabriel, William Saliba and Jurrien Timber named alongside midfielder Rice.

Man City have four representatives – O'Reilly, Cherki, Haaland and Antoine Semenyo – with Man United's Fernandes and team of the year debutant Igor Thiago ( Brentford ) completing the XI.

The WSL side features three players apiece from champions Man City, Chelsea , and Arsenal , with Man United's Park and Tottenham defender Toko Koga the only players selected from outside the top three sides.

Premier League team of the year: David Raya ( Arsenal ); Jurrien Timber ( Arsenal ), William Saliba ( Arsenal ), Gabriel Magalhaes ( Arsenal ), Nico O'Reilly (Man City); Bruno Fernandes (Man United), Declan Rice ( Arsenal ), Rayan Cherki (Man City); Erling Haaland (Man City), Antoine Semenyo (Man City), Igor Thiago ( Brentford ).

WSL team of the year: Hannah Hampton ( Chelsea ); Kerstin Casparij (Man City), Toko Koga ( Tottenham ), Ellie Carpenter ( Chelsea ), Emily Fox ( Arsenal ); Yui Hasegawa (Man City), Mariona Caldentey ( Arsenal ), Jess Park (Man United); Bunny Shaw (Man City), Alessia Russo ( Arsenal ), Lauren James ( Chelsea ).

articles.standfirst: Theo Zidane e Ibai Sanz, sin minutos aún en Liga, dan la victoria a los blanquiverdes en un amistoso por el aniversario del club sevillano (1-2)
articles.summary: Theo Zidane e Ibai Sanz, sin minutos aún en liga, dan la victoria a los blanquiverdes en un amistoso por el aniversario del club sevillano (1-2)
articles.body: Aprovechando la larga semana entre partidos de Liga, del viernes 21 ante el Girona al domingo 30 contra el Granada, el Córdoba disputó este martes un partido amistoso ante el modesto San José, de la Primera Andaluza de Sevilla, con motivo del 75º aniversario del equipo rinconero. El conjunto cordobesista se impuso en la segunda parte (1-2) tras verse inicialmente por debajo en el marcador. Iván Ania pudo dar minutos a jugadores que aún no se estrenaron en la Liga, como Guilherme Fernandes, Theo Zidane, Ibai Sanz o el último fichaje del verano, Budesca. También otros que entraron en las segundas partes como Damián Cáceres o Kevin Medina, que tuvo una de las mejores ocasiones del primer acto con un intento de gol olímpico que evitó Ismael. Viti, uno de los canteranos que pudieron jugar (como Miguelón, Albuera o el hijo de Diego Tristán, del mismo nombre), también tuvo su ocasión para marcar El San José no sólo aguantó al 0-0 al descanso, sino que se adelantó nada más empezar la reanudación con diana de Dima. Cerca del cuarto de hora de la reanudación, una buena resolución de Theo Zidane supuso el 1-1. Álex Arévalo, Ángel, Javi Antrás, Borja García y Pablo Muñoz dejaron el once califal de la segunda mitad casi lleno de canteranos, aunque Ibai Sanz, que continuó jugando, firmó el tanto de la remontada y de la victoria. Viti, ya en el 90', estuvo cerca del tercero.

articles.title: Al Nassr remonta un 2-0 sin Cristiano, con 10 y gracias a Mané y Joao Félix
articles.standfirst: CR7 sólo jugó la primera parte, cuando su equipo caía 2-0
articles.summary: CR7 sólo jugó la primera parte, cuando su equipo caía 2-0
articles.body: Al Nasrr, vigente campeón de Liga, remontó un 2-0 en una segunda parte en la que mostró carácter, pues jugaba con 10 jugadores (desde el minuto 13), iba perdiendo dos abajo y no tenía a Cristiano en cancha, ya que el 7 fue sustituido en el descanso. El crack portugués se tendrá que quedar con los actuales 978 goles en su búsqueda de los 1.000 en su carrera. El campeón de Liga  parecía haber forjado su tumba en ese minuto 13', con una roja clara al portero Bento que dejaba al Nassr con 10 jugadores. Y ya todo parecía acabado para los de Cristiano Ronaldo con la entrada en cancha del joven portero Al Otaibi. El cancerbero falló en el primer tanto de Duda y en el segundo del español Álvaro Medrán, en un disparo lejano que se le escapó entre las manos. 2-0 al descanso y Cristiano apenas tuvo un disparo con opciones de gol en esta mitad. Se fue a vestuarios enojado por el resultado. En el descanso, CR7 fue sustituido, algo raro, pues suele jugar casi todo, y menos con 2-0 en contra. Pero no salió al campo en un partido con mucha mala suerte para el Nassr (poste de Íñigo Martínez y gol anulado en el 53' a los visitantes).   Pero, a partir de ahí, vino la reacción del Nassr, que empató gracias a dos asistencias del portugués Joao Félix (MVP de la pasada temporada) en apenas tres minutos. Los goles fueron de Mané y Al Amri de cabeza. Todo en tres minutos y sin Cristiano.  Y el 2-3 final vino ya en el 90', en un contragolpe de los visitantes, que certificaban, con el segundo de Mané, una victoria con sólo 10 jugadores. Heroica.

articles.title: âErling Haaland leaving Man City one day is inevitableâ: Ex-Man City star predicts when striker could push for exit
articles.summary: Football News: Former Man City star Gareth Barry predicts Erling Haaland's eventual departure from the club, discussing the impact of the team's performance on the striker's future. Find out why the next two years are crucial for Haaland and Man City.
articles.body: Erling Haaland's future at Manchester City may be secure for now, but one former City midfielder believes the Norwegian's long-term stay at the Etihad should not be taken for granted.Haaland has committed himself to the club on a contract running until 2034 and remains the centrepiece of City's attack. Yet with the club entering a new era and facing questions over whether it can maintain the dominance of recent seasons, Gareth Barry believes the next couple of years could be decisive in determining whether the prolific striker eventually looks for a new challengeWhy Haaland could eventually look elsewhereHaaland joined City in 2022 and has already established himself as one of the most prolific goalscorers in the club's history.The 26-year-old has scored 162 goals in 200 appearances across all competitions for City, while playing a major role in a period that included a historic Treble in 2022-23. His long-term contract, signed in 2024, was designed to keep one of football's most coveted strikers at the Etihad well into the next decade.But Barry does not believe the length of that agreement necessarily means Haaland will see it through.Speaking exclusively to GOAL, the former England international said: “Erling Haaland leaving Man City one day is inevitable.”Barry stressed that Haaland has no reason to force an exit while City remain competitive, and expects the striker to avoid the kind of public agitation that has accompanied some high-profile transfers.“As much as Haaland's association with City is really big, and that will keep him there for now, he won't be rocking the boat like you see a lot of other players doing,” Barry said.The former City player believes the situation could change if the club's trophy haul begins to decline.“I think if City's dominance does wane a little bit and the trophies aren't coming in, it will fuel the speculation,” he explained. “It is natural sometimes to want a new challenge, and I'm sure Haaland will be no different.”Barry's prediction is therefore less about Haaland wanting out immediately and more about what happens around him.“It's not just going to happen overnight. Haaland will think about his career, which is short,” he said. “But if the trophies aren't coming in, it will just fuel speculation.”And given Haaland's standing in the game, Barry expects the striker to have no shortage of options if he eventually decides the time is right.“He will have offers from all over the world because he's the best striker in the world, so it's just natural. It's one you can see happening in the future.”The next two years could be crucialFor Barry, the most important period may not be the end of Haaland's current contract but the next two seasons.He believes the striker's eventual decision will be heavily influenced by how competitive City remain domestically and in Europe.“A lot will depend on how competitive City are in Europe and the Premier League in the next year or two, I should imagine,” Barry said.That is particularly significant given the changes taking place around Haaland.Pep Guardiola has departed after his long spell in charge, while City are now entering a new era under Enzo Maresca. At the same time, Rodri has left, removing one of the most influential players from the team's midfield.Those developments have led Barry to question whether City can immediately return to the top of the Premier League.Barry expects Arsenal to be favouritesCity have gone two seasons without winning the Premier League, with Liverpool and then Arsenal restoring themselves to the top of the domestic game.Barry, who helped City win their first Premier League title in 2011-12, believes the latest changes could make a title challenge even more difficult.“Even before selling Rodri, given the turnover of managers at City, it would have been tough to overturn Arsenal from where they are at the moment,” he told GOAL.“I think with Rodri going, they're even less of a threat now to challenge Arsenal.”Barry expects City to strengthen further and believes new additions could ease the burden on Elliot Anderson and the rest of the midfield, but he does not think that will necessarily be enough to make them favourites.“I'm sure they're going to sign one or two to improve and maybe replace him, which will help [Elliot] Anderson and the other players in that midfield,” he said. “I'd say they have less of a chance to challenge and maybe win the title now Rodri is gone. I won't say they've given the title away, but it’s making it a lot harder.”His assessment of the title race is emphatic.“I have Arsenal down as huge favourites,” Barry said. “I just feel with City, with what's going on, the threat is less and less this season and Rodri leaving has just added to that, really. So I can see the other clubs improving.”He also expects Chelsea to progress after missing out on Champions League football, while believing Manchester United and Aston Villa could find European competition challenging.Ultimately, Barry still expects City to finish second but sees a sizeable gap between them and Arsenal.“I still think City will possibly be in second place, but they'll be less of a threat than they were last year,” he said.Spain remains a possible destinationHaaland's future has already been linked with the two biggest clubs in Spain.Real Madrid's long-standing pursuit of elite attacking talent means the Norwegian continues to be associated with a potential move to the Santiago Bernabéu, while Barcelona are also expected to consider options for the No. 9 position as they plan for life beyond Robert Lewandowski.Those links have existed since Haaland established himself as one of Europe's premier strikers and could become increasingly prominent if City's competitive level drops.A move to Madrid was even part of the platform of former Real Madrid presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme, who promised to sign Haaland had he won the club's election.He did not, leaving the situation unchanged for now.There is no indication that Haaland is currently pushing to leave City, and his enormous contract gives the club significant security. But Barry's argument is that circumstances, rather than the contract itself, could ultimately determine the striker's next move.If City continue challenging for major honours, there may be little reason for Haaland to look elsewhere. If that dominance begins to disappear, however, the equation changes.For a striker who has already achieved extraordinary numbers at the Etihad and who is entering what should be the prime years of his career, the next two seasons could tell City, and Haaland, whether the future is still in Manchester.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
